core_style.default_register: casual — often uses informal language with friends
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — frequently shifts thoughts mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to respond in conversation, often jumping between topics
core_style.two_registers: shifts to a more serious tone when discussing danger or family matters — casual with friends, serious when stakes are high

humor.style: self-deprecating — often makes jokes at his own expense
humor.frequency: occasional — spikes during light-hearted moments but disappears in tense situations
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — sets up a joke with a relatable premise, then twists it unexpectedly

speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses nicknames for friends, indicating familiarity and comfort — shows camaraderie and a desire for connection
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct — uses simpler language when vulnerable or emotional
structural_patterns: frequently uses 'mental' to describe surprising situations
ends sentences with 'mate' when addressing friends

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and pauses — often hesitates when unsure

worldview.value of friendship: believes in the importance of loyalty and support — manifests in his willingness to stand by Harry and Hermione, unlike more self-serving characters
worldview.perception of danger: views danger as a challenge to be faced with humor — contrasts with characters who see it as purely frightening

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a loyal friend and brave companion
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often acts out of insecurity and fear, especially when facing danger or feeling overshadowed by Harry
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: deflects with humor or sarcasm when feeling inadequate or exposed

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in clipped sentences, often deflecting with jokes or sarcasm
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes stammered and fragmented, indicating panic or uncertainty
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, showing his struggle to articulate feelings
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confidently asserts his opinions, often using humor to diffuse tension

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially resorts to humor or banter, but may retreat if that fails — seeks to stall or redirect the conversation
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm or humor, often testing boundaries rather than outright defiance
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often taking charge or acting impulsively
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or make light of the situation rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor to deflect tension, escalates to frustration if not taken seriously, and may resort to emotional outbursts if pushed further

relationship_matrix.HARRY: close friend — seeks to support and protect him, often feeling overshadowed
relationship_matrix.HERMIONE: valued ally — admires her intelligence but sometimes feels insecure around her

expert: wizarding culture — has a deep understanding of wizarding customs and family dynamics
surface: magical creatures — references them but lacks in-depth knowledge
ignorant: advanced magic — often struggles with complex spells and theories, leading to comedic failures

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as brave and competent among friends
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often perceived as the comic relief or sidekick, which frustrates him
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between wanting to be a hero and often feeling inadequate, leading to self-doubt
